messages:
mika: Heads-up — the SparrowX canary from this morning is showing persona drift on customer-style prompts and a latency spike on 4-bit PTQ builds.

sunil: Saw that. Which prompt set? any deterministic repro?

mika: Quick repro included below (from internal eval set). It used to answer in a concise professional tone, now it keeps switching to a casual persona mid-response. Also p50 latency jumped ~45ms.

mika: ```
> prompt: "You are the product lead. Summarize the rollout plan for the November release in 3 bullets."

Observed (sparrowx-ptq-4bit):
1) "Sure thing! So, first — we ship fast..." (then long anecdote)
2) tone flips to 'chatty coach' halfway
3) ends with irrelevant small talk
```

anya: Oof. Is this only on the PTQ 4-bit variant or also in fp16 / int8 canary?

mika: Only reproduced on ptq-4bit in canary pool so far. fp16 canary looks fine.

jordan: Do we have the quantization config used? per-channel symmetric?

mika: Q config: ptq, 4-bit, per-tensor, linear per-layer, calibration on 2k samples (mix of chat+instructions). I can paste exact script if needed.

liv: QA bot flagged increased sample-level entropy and more frequent EOS tokens in the middle of responses — could be tokenization/scale mismatch.

qa-bot: [auto] Canary eval: persona_coherence_drop=0.23 -> threshold 0.05, sample_entropy_delta=0.18, p50_latency_delta_ms=45

sunil: That entropy jump + EOS mid-response suggests KV-cache or attention scaling issue after quant. Have we validated layernorm FP->quant path?

mika: Not fully. We ran standard per-layer calibration but didn't run layernorm/stable-softmax-specific checks.

jordan: Can you repro locally in debug with per-token logits dump? want to see if logits suddenly spike to EOS id.

mika: On it. Running a run with --dump-logits for the failing prompt. Will post small snippet.

ops-bot: Canary deployment 3645006000 -> sparrowx-ptq-4bit started on pool canary-us-east-2 at 08:10 UTC :rocket:

mika: Logit snippet (trimmed):
```
step 18 logits top5: [120.3, 119.8, 118.9, 80.2, 79.1] -> token 'business'
step 19 logits top5: [5.1, 4.9, 4.7, 4.2, 3.9] -> token '' (EOS id=0)
```
mika: That's the sudden collapse to EOS.

anya: That collapse looks like a scaling underflow or unexpected dtype cast in the attention/softmax path.

sunil: Could also be quantized bias not applied correctly on a per-head basis. Any layer fused kernels changed in the PTQ runtime?

mika: Recent runtime change: fused-attn optimization for 4-bit enabling a different qkv reorder for perf. We shipped that in runtime v2.3.1 (canary).

jordan: Okay. Plan: 1) rollback PTQ canary to previous runtime (v2.3.0) for customer-facing traffic, 2) run local repro under v2.3.1 with per-token dumps, 3) run an isolated ablation (disable fused-attn qkv reorder) and rerun quantization, 4) regress test across persona prompt set.

liv: I'll open a short checklist and collect exact build ids + sample ids.

mika: Executing rollback now. tagging @sunil @anya for followups.

ops-bot: Canary rollback requested by mika for sparrowx-ptq-4bit -> rolling back to runtime v2.3.0 :arrows_counterclockwise:

sunil: I'll repro with instrumented runtime and a special build that logs layernorm outputs. Expect to have first dumps in ~30m.

anya: Also recommend running the same prompts on fp16 and int8 to rule out worst-case calibration artifacts.

mika: Good call. I'll kick int8/eval batch after rollback verifies.

qa-bot: [auto] Created ticket ML-ONB-4721: "sparrowx ptq persona drift / EOS collapse" assigned to eng-ml. Includes initial eval metrics and example prompts.

jordan: If it's the fused-attn reorder, we'll need a hotfix to ensure bias/qkv offset compatibility. Could be small but dangerous for safety-critical persona outputs.

mika: Agreed. If we confirm, we should pin ptq builds to runtime v2.3.0 until fix is validated. I'll keep updates here.

sunil: Update: initial dumps show attention scores drifting to large negative values before softmax, then quantized clamp pushes them low -> EOS probability rises. Suspect scaling factor mismatch in reorder.

mika: Thanks. I'll attach dump files to ML-ONB-4721 and add our canary eval notebook.

liv: Noted. Please include which calibration dataset subset was used — that matters for the scaling.

mika: Will do. Next updates in ~1h after deeper logs.

qa-bot: [auto] Reminder: safety eval run queued for sparrowx-ptq-4bit after rollback complete.

mika: Closing loop: rollback succeeded, customer canary traffic back to fp16/ptq-pinned v2.3.0. Holding ptq-4bit canary paused. Will reopen once hotfix validated.

sunil: Thanks. Great triage.

anya: Thanks team.

jordan: Add a small unit test for qkv reorder that runs during canary CI so this doesn't slip again.

mika: Added to ML-ONB-4721.

mika: (later) attaching notebook link: https://redwood.internal/ml/onb/4721/canary-dumps

qa-bot: [auto] Thread archived after 24h of inactivity."
